title: Attractive Potholders
text: Attractive Potholders. I liked the way these potholders looked in the picture. It said the company is a U.S. company, but what I wasn’t able to see is “MADE IN CHINA”. If I had known that I never would have purchased them. i am a firm believer in supporting American made products and American workers.  I wish Amazon felt the same.

product_metadata.title: Premium Pot Holders - 500°F Heat Resistant - Non Slip Textured Silicone Grip - Washable Mittens for Cooking Baking - Flexible Soft Terry Cloth Cotton Lining - Set of 2 by Cook'n'Chic
features: HEAT RESISTANT UP TO 500°F: These pot holders have an outer surface made entirely of genuine siliconePRIME and are lined with terry cloth cotton, making them resistant to high temperatures. This makes them a safe and comfortable choice for cooking or baking in the kitchen.

NON-SLIP TEXTURED GRIP: The silicone outer layer of these pot holders is designed featuring a unique Lingonberry Fest engraved artwork. Not only does this contribute to the style of the pot holders, it also gives them a better slip-resistant grip, meaning you can handle hot pots and pans with confidence.

EASY MAINTENANCE: When using these pot holders to handle steaming loads of food, they're likely to pick up some mess and sweat along the way. That's why we've ensured that the pot holders are totally machine washable for quick and easy maintenance.

SIGNATURE COLLECTION: These pot holders feature a big, high-quality embroidered logo on the front. These silicone kitchen mittens coordinate with any other pair from our Cook'n'Chic’s Signature Collection and share a coherent style with our aprons, oven mitts, and other products.
100% HASSLE-FREE WARRANTY: Customer satisfaction is our number one priority, which is why we offer a one-year warranty on all of our products. Just register your purchase online. No questions asked!
